items.title: Polanski vows to stay on as Green leader as criticism mounts
items.summary: Jewish Greens' leader has said Polanski should resign in the wake of a Zionism row and by-election defeat.

items.title: And the Nobel Peace Prize goes to...
items.summary: Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, a South African jurist and former UN high commissioner for human rights, has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize.

items.title: New evidence gives family hope after death in Spain
items.summary: Tobias White-Sansom, from Nottingham, was on a family holiday in Spain and died on a night out.

items.title: Andrew granted £302,000 compensation after lease on Royal Lodge home officially surrendered
items.summary: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor has been granted £302,000 in compensation after his lease on his former Royal Lodge home in Windsor was officially surrendered, a Crown Estate spokesperson said.

items.title: Teen's life transformed by gene editing
items.summary: Vian, 16, has thalassemia and had to have monthly blood transfusions throughout her childhood.

items.title: Drought declared in Yorkshire
items.summary: Drought has been declared in Yorkshire due to a lack of spring and summer rainfall, the Environment Agency has said.
